title: Does Machine Learning Outperform Traditional Fibrosis Scores in Predicting Liver Cirrhosis Risk? A Longitudinal EHR-Based Study
abstract: arXiv:2601.00175v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Objective: Develop and evaluate machine learning (ML) models for predicting incident liver cirrhosis (LC) one and two years before diagnosis using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data and compare their performance with the FIB-4 and APRI clinical scores. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using de-identified EHR data from a large academic health system. Adult patients with diagnostic evidence of LC or LC-related risk conditions were identified using ICD-9/10 codes and classified into cirrhosis and non-cirrhosis cohorts. One- and two-year prediction scenarios were created using observation and prediction windows. Demographics, diagnoses, laboratory results, and vital signs from the observation window were used as predictors. translated_title: 机器学习在预测肝硬化风险方面是否优于传统纤维化评分？一项基于电子健康记录的纵向研究
translated_abstract: 目的：开发并评估机器学习（ML）模型，利用常规收集的电子健康记录（EHR）数据在肝硬化（LC）确诊前一年和两年预测其发病风险，并将其性能与FIB-4和APRI临床评分进行比较。方法：我们利用某大型学术医疗系统的去标识化EHR数据开展了一项回顾性队列研究。通过ICD-9/10编码识别具有肝硬化或肝硬化相关风险疾病诊断证据的成年患者，并将其划分为肝硬化队列和非肝硬化队列。通过观察窗和预测窗构建一年和两年的预测场景，将观察窗内的人口统计学信息、诊断、实验室检验结果和生命体征作为预测因子。研究开发了结合特征选择与贝叶斯超参数调优的XGBoost模型，并在留出测试集上进行评估，随后对XGBoost、FIB-4和APRI的性能进行了比较。
tldr: 该研究基于纵向电子健康记录数据开发了结合特征选择和贝叶斯超参数调优的XGBoost机器学习模型，能够在肝硬化确诊前一至两年预测发病风险，并与传统FIB-4和APRI纤维化评分进行了性能对比。
en_tdlr: This study developed XGBoost machine learning models with feature selection and Bayesian hyperparameter tuning using longitudinal EHR data to predict incident liver cirrhosis one and two years before diagnosis, benchmarking their performance against traditional FIB-4 and APRI fibrosis scores.
